full_judgment: 6. It appears that the accused person are influential and affluent persons of the locality; that Shahabuddin was also man of affluence and both the parties belonging of the same family. Therefore, in a situation like this the High Court Division did not find any reason to draw any adverse presumption because of the non-examination of the two witnesses namely, Al-Amin and Mostafa, rather it is evident that P.W.4 the other witness i.e. sole available eye witness who was present at the time of taking tea in the tea stall when the accused person encircled and opened shots from their fire arms aiming Shahabuddin and in the melee Mostafa had also sustained injury.
